name: Charts
description: Data visualisation on one shared surface. Crystal named no charting component before 2.0 while every React benchmark shipped one; these are specified against MUI X Charts, PrimeReact Chart and Mantine Charts. Every chart owes a text equivalent of its data — a chart is a second representation, never the only one.

components.name: Chart surface
components.anatomy: The shared frame every chart draws into: plot area, axes, grid, legend and tooltip slots.
components.material: Haze plot fill on the surrounding material
components.geometry: Plot area keeps the content radius; the legend is a list of pills.
components.semantics: Each chart has an accessible name and a table equivalent of its data.
components.crystal: Materials, grid and axis colour, focus order, empty and loading surfaces

components.name: Bar chart
components.anatomy: Categorical values as bars, grouped or stacked.
components.geometry: Bars keep a small radius on the value end only.
components.semantics: Every series is named; values are reachable as text.
components.crystal: Bar geometry, series colour from the palette, enter motion

components.name: Line chart
components.anatomy: Continuous values as lines, with optional points.
components.geometry: Line weight follows the stroke scale; points reach 44px of hit area.
components.semantics: Series are distinguishable without colour alone.
components.crystal: Stroke scale, point geometry, draw-on motion

components.name: Area chart
components.anatomy: A line chart with the region beneath it filled.
components.geometry: Fill never obscures gridlines beneath it.
components.crystal: Fill material and opacity so overlaps stay readable

components.name: Pie chart
components.anatomy: Parts of a whole as segments.
components.geometry: Segments separated by a hairline in the surface colour.
components.semantics: Each segment is labelled with its value; the total is stated.
components.crystal: Segment colour ordering, separation, enter motion

components.name: Donut chart
components.anatomy: A pie with a hole, often carrying a summary value.
components.geometry: Ring thickness is a declared proportion of the radius.
components.semantics: The centre value is text, not an image.

components.name: Scatter chart
components.geometry: Point size is a scale, not an arbitrary radius.
components.semantics: Dense regions remain describable; a table equivalent is required.

components.name: Radar chart
components.material: Haze fill inside each series polygon
components.geometry: Axis labels sit outside the outer ring.
components.semantics: Axes are labelled; series are named.
components.crystal: Fill opacity so overlapping series stay readable

components.name: Spark line
components.anatomy: A small trend line with no axes, sized to sit inside text or a cell.
components.geometry: Fixed aspect; no padding of its own.
components.semantics: Needs a text summary beside it; it is never the only carrier of the value.

components.name: Gauge
components.anatomy: A single value against a range, drawn as an arc.
components.material: Haze track with a primary arc
components.crystal: Arc geometry, threshold colour from status tokens

components.name: Heatmap
components.anatomy: A matrix of values shown as cell intensity.
components.geometry: Cells are square with a hairline gap.
components.semantics: Intensity is paired with a value; colour alone never carries meaning.
components.crystal: Scale construction, contrast floor at every step

components.name: Funnel chart
components.anatomy: Sequential stages narrowing toward an outcome.
components.geometry: Stages meet without gaps; labels sit outside when they do not fit.
components.semantics: Each stage states its absolute and relative value.

components.name: Chart legend
components.anatomy: Names the series in a chart and toggles them.
components.semantics: Toggles are buttons with a pressed state; hidden series are announced.
components.crystal: Entry material, pressed state, selection by weight

components.name: Chart tooltip
components.anatomy: Values at a position, following the pointer or the focused item.
components.geometry: Panel radius; never covers the point it describes.
components.semantics: Mirrors the tooltip contract: reachable by keyboard, dismissible with Escape.
components.product: Which values appear and their format
